The '''Bestal system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|system]] in the [[Varada sector/Legends|Varada sector]], located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bestal Three]] and the [[Kadal Asteroid Field]] among others. [[Tyanna Tymb]] purchased the resource and trade rights to this system for the [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], but found that [[Fax Ventures]] already owned Bestal Three and the Kadal Asteroid Field.
